# HC DrawIO Rules

- Use uncompressed XML with globally unique `mxCell` IDs.
- Every node needs positive geometry, `html=1`, and readable wrapped text.
- Keep sibling node gaps at least 30 pixels; connect edges to node IDs instead of coordinates.
- Use `rounded=1;orthogonalLoop=1;jumpStyle=arc;jumpSize=6` for ordinary edges.
- Do not use in-figure titles, decorative shadows, gradients, or unexplained icons.
- Export a cropped PDF and keep its source `.drawio` file beside it.
